name: Crispy Cod with Lemon Parsley Sauce & Tomato-Arugula Panzanella Salad

instructions.primary_message: Cut or tear bread into 2-inch pieces. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 slices sourdough bread
extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until croutons are golden and toasted, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lemon
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
6 tomatoes
1 (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Zest lemon into a small bowl. Add flour and spices, then stir to combine the coating. (Reserve lemon for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp all-purpose flour
salt
black pepper
½ tsp paprika
oregano, dried

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat cod dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Sprinkle with the coating on both sides. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cod and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil to keep warm.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in the reserved bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl, along with oil, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the sauce. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, vinegar, and spices in a large bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp red wine vinegar
oregano, dried
salt
black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice shallot lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Large dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl, along with cooled croutons, arugula, and capers, then toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and cod between plates or bowls. Spoon sauce over the cod and enjoy!
